objective: Unify Public and scoped BUKLOD Community Wall captions: single-line preview with inline See more, and enlarged typography for text-only posts up to 80 characters.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source SHA 8e1956e617a65b3350b3fba81597fc86604da4a1; latest verified production Android OTA identified in PR #515 as update 01a1afda-304b-72a7-a859-8799f25ac602, runtime 1.3.2. This DEV patch makes no production/RC/OTA claim.
chosenApproach: Reuse the canonical mention renderer with a one-row collapsed caption and accessible inline toggle; make both Public and scoped feeds pass media presence. Large typography is limited to <=80-codepoint text-only posts.
selectionRationale: One presentation component changes only visible captions. Existing photo/video renderer, reactions, composer, pagination and authorization remain owned by their original containers.
preserveBehaviors: Public and scoped photo collages, videos, signed URLs and caches unchanged
All composer actions, reaction and comment controls unchanged
No feed pagination, scroll reset, ads, navigation or authorization modification
No backend, RLS, native dependency, runtime or production OTA modification
acceptanceChecks: Media posts show one compact caption line before expansion
Long captions expose accessible inline See more and See less
Text-only posts up to 80 Unicode code points render as enlarged type
Public and Organization/Sub-organization/Cluster use the same component
Regression coverage passes on the exact branch head
Caption expansion never replaces list keys, scroll anchors, pagination or refresh callbacks
alternativeApproaches: Replace the full Wall feed card (rejected: risks media and scroll regressions)
Truncate captions at 280 characters (rejected: does not honor one-line preview)
Create separate Public and scoped caption renderers (rejected: causes drift)
